subject.title: [Feature]: Allow agents to resolve Slack channel IDs to names via channel-info/channel-list

question: Should Slack channel discovery land as a focused `channel-info`/`channel-list` implementation or continue through the broad Slack action-parity PR?
rationale: The requested feature is valid, but the active implementation path is a protected broad PR with security and proof blockers, so automation should not queue duplicate repair without maintainer direction.

options.title: Split focused discovery work
options.body: Land a smaller Slack PR for only `channel-info` and `channel-list`, preserving read authorization and leaving broader search/delivery features for separate review.

options.title: Continue broad parity PR
options.body: Use the open Slack parity PR as the canonical path, but require its security, proof, mergeability, and scope concerns to be resolved before this issue closes.

options.title: Defer Slack discovery
options.body: Keep the issue open as an accepted feature request but do not queue implementation until maintainers are ready to revisit Slack action surface expansion.

recommendation.title: Split focused discovery work
recommendation.body: Land a smaller Slack PR for only `channel-info` and `channel-list`, preserving read authorization and leaving broader search/delivery features for separate review.

likelyOwner.reason: This person owns the currently open broad Slack parity candidate and has recent Slack docs/action history relevant to choosing the merge shape.
